rules.title: Model output passed to eval or a shell
rules.why: An LLM can be steered by prompt injection to return code or commands; executing its output hands that control to whoever can influence the prompt.
rules.fix: Never execute model output. Parse a constrained format and map it to allow-listed actions.

rules.title: User text interpolated into a system prompt
rules.why: Putting user text in the system role lets it override your instructions (prompt injection).
rules.fix: Keep the system prompt constant and pass user text as a user message.
